verdict.rationale: The evidence pack lists a first-party Incident Management docs page under incident_response, which indicates Datadog has its own capability for declaring and tracking incidents. The entry is only a title, though, and nothing in the pack describes incident timelines, on-call schedules, or escalation policies. Community use of notebooks during incidents is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented incident timelines, on-call scheduling, escalation policies, detail on incident declaration and tracking workflow, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an SRE, I can declare and track incidents with timelines, on-call schedules, and escalation policies
